description: Descriptive technical read for a crypto asset on closed 15m/1h/4h/1d candles: bias (strong bearish ... strong bullish), trend (up/down/mixed) and regime (trending/ranging) from RSI, MACD, EMA 20/50/200, Bollinger and ADX. Free preview tier. The paid x402 routes add every indicator value and the bias components (/v1/lite), VaR/CVaR, drawdowns and ATR position sizing (/v1/risk) and rule backtests (/v1/backtest). Read-only analytics; not financial advice.

symbol.description: Base asset ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE (BTC-PERP, ETH-USD and SOLUSDT are accepted too)
